name: Maintenance Schedule

native.query: SELECT a.code as asset_code, a.name, ms.type as maintenance_type, ms.next_due as scheduled_date, 'SCHEDULED' as status FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.asset_maintenance_logs ms JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.asset_items a ON a.id = ms.asset_id WHERE ms.next_due BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY ms.next_due

cards.name: Chi Phí Bảo Trì Theo Tháng

native.query: SELECT date_trunc('month', done_at) as month, SUM(cost) as total_cost FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.asset_maintenance_logs WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
